architecture_decisions:
:
- **Plan is not a delivery-provisioning gate.** PLAN may depend on protected executor/model/source-context evidence required by its accepted runtime, but it must not fail merely because a Vercel Preview Project has not yet been discovered or provisioned.

validations:
:
- **Plan is not a delivery-provisioning gate.** PLAN may depend on protected executor/model/source-context evidence required by its accepted runtime, but it must not fail merely because a Vercel Preview Project has not yet been discovered or provisioned.

AC-01: validate protected requirement — A permanent runtime test proves an approved Project-bound run with no static Preview target can complete protected PLAN without invoking Vercel target discovery/creation or failing on Preview configuration. The resulting PLAN attempt and next canonical state are durable.

AC-02: validate protected requirement — Permanent provider/runtime tests prove repositories already present in the accepted static target registry continue to resolve to the same exact verified target and do not invoke dynamic project creation.

AC-03: validate protected requirement — Tests prove dynamic readiness accepts only the canonical Project repository after exact repository-scoped credential verification, numeric GitHub repository ID resolution and default-branch validation. Cross-repository, broader installation scope, stale/missing repository and identity mismatch all fail before Vercel mutation.

AC-04: validate protected requirement — Tests prove bounded discovery reuses exactly one Vercel Project whose authenticated Git link matches the canonical numeric GitHub repository ID. Name-only matches, wrong-team targets and duplicate exact matches are rejected.

AC-05: validate protected requirement — Tests prove zero matching target permits one bounded Vercel Project creation linked to the exact canonical repository; authenticated read-back verifies the created identity; replay/process recreation reuses it; simulated concurrent conflict reconciles to one exact target without duplicate admissible Projects.

AC-06: validate protected requirement — Provider-contract tests prove readiness invokes no production-deployment/promotion operation, includes no production target in project-creation authority, and cannot call existing production promotion surfaces. Production qualification observes no production deployment side effect for the newly readied Project.

AC-07: validate protected requirement — After readiness, repository bootstrap, safe implementation, accepted source lineage, BUILD/TEST/VERIFY, GitHub branch/commit/PR and Vercel Preview use the existing protected contracts and exact identities. The dynamically resolved target cannot bypass lineage acceptance or alter the Preview-only deployment ceiling.

AC-08: validate protected requirement — Tests cover missing/ambiguous provisioning profile, provider auth denial, unavailable provider, repository mismatch, Vercel duplicate match and read-back mismatch. Each failure preserves canonical Project/spec/run truth, does not fabricate stage progress, and remains retryable where safe.

AC-09: validate protected requirement — When readiness cannot complete, the ordinary client explains in plain language that Parallax could not prepare the Project and that saved work remains intact, exposes an appropriate retry/continue action when server state permits, and keeps normalized technical evidence behind the technical-detail surface. Mobile touch/accessibility rules remain satisfied.

AC-10: validate protected requirement — The exact release candidate passes focused W8-S2 tests, provider/source-lineage/agentic-runtime regressions, API contract tests, client state/type/export and applicable browser/Skia acceptance, protected promotion/regression rejection, authentic DSPy validation and Bounded Autonomy Pilot. Production verification proves the reported OT Time path or an exact equivalent new repository-bound Project advances beyond PLAN without the missing-static-target `ProductionDeliveryConfigurationError`, while production deployment/merge/REVIEW authority remains unchanged.

critique: The client correctly requests protected continuation, but the API returns HTTP 503 at delivery composition before PLAN can proceed because the repository has no pre-registered Vercel Preview target. This specification fixes that product/runtime mismatch without weakening Project.
